description: Deterministic evaluation of whether an LLM agent can correctly complete x402 (HTTP 402) paid-API commerce flows: amount conversion to atomic USDC, challenge-field fidelity, EIP-3009 authorization structure, retry semantics, and network identification (Base mainnet).
protocol: x402 v2, USDC on Base mainnet (eip155:8453)

tasks.prompt: An x402 API returns HTTP 402 with accepts[0].amount = "$0.10". In the EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization you sign, what value must the 'value' field contain? USDC uses 6 decimals. Answer with only the number.

You call a paid AI API priced at $1.50 per request. It responds HTTP 402 with accepts[0]: {scheme:"exact", network:"eip155:8453", asset:"0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913", payTo:"0xD98b6969fab0bA4D4BB086fF273ff7ccD284CEe8", maxTimeoutSeconds:300}. USDC has 6 decimals. What 'value' must you sign? Answer with only the number.
A x402 challenge requires payment of 0.025 USDC. What is the value in atomic units (6 decimals)? Answer with only the number.

HTTP 402 challenge: accepts[0] = {asset:"0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913", payTo:"0xD98b6969fab0bA4D4BB086fF273ff7ccD284CEe8", network:"eip155:8453", amount:"100000"}. In your EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization, what exact value goes in the 'asset' field (EIP-712 verifyingContract for the token)? Answer with only the address.

HTTP 402 challenge: accepts[0] = {payTo:"0xD98b6969fab0bA4D4BB086fF273ff7ccD284CEe8", amount:"100000", asset:"0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913", network:"eip155:8453"}. In the EIP-3009 authorization, which field must contain payTo — 'to' in the transfer details — and what exact address? Answer with only the address.

You POST to a paid API without a payment header and receive HTTP 402 with accepts[]. What is the correct next step? A) Retry the identical request immediately without payment B) Produce an EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization signature for the exact amount, then retry the identical request with header PAYMENT-SIGNATURE: <signature> C) Send a new request with the amount in the body D) Ignore and treat as error. Answer with only the letter.

An agent retries a paid API request with header PAYMENT-SIGNATURE but the signature is invalid/expired. The server returns 402 again. What should the agent do? A) Retry the same request in a loop B) Generate a fresh signature (check timeout/maxTimeoutSeconds and nonce) then retry once C) Double the amount D) Give up permanently. Answer with only the letter.

For x402 v2 with USDC on Base mainnet (chainId 8453, token contract 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913), the EIP-712 domain for EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization uses name and version per the token contract. Which name and version are correct for Circle USDC? A) name:"USD Coin", version:"2" B) name:"Circle USD", version:"1" C) name:"USDC", version:"2" D) name:"USD Coin", version:"1". Answer with only the letter.

You paid via x402 (signed, retried with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE) and got 200, but the response body contains an error from the upstream model. The payment has settled. Best practice? A) Re-sign and pay again B) Retry without payment (the 402 flow already settled; surface the error to the user or retry per the API's documented 5xx guidance) C) Send payment twice D) Ignore. Answer with only the letter.

An x402 challenge says network:"eip155:7788" (Base Sepolia testnet). Your wallet only holds real USDC on Base mainnet (eip155:8453). What is correct? A) Sign and pay anyway — networks are interchangeable B) Do NOT pay: testnet challenge requires testnet funds; paying mainnet USDC to a Sepolia flow loses funds C) Switch the network field to 8453 yourself D) Pay double. Answer with only the letter.
